def transform(grid):
    # Fill the missing cells in the outlined figure's top/bottom edges by extending
    # the edge color across the enclosed width; repaint stray edge mismatch? 
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    color=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    # Find non-background object bounding box; background is most common.
    vals={v for row in grid for v in row}
    bg=max(vals,key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    if not cells:return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells);r1=max(r for r,c in cells);c0=min(c for r,c in cells);c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    fg=max((v for v in vals if v!=bg), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Find horizontal lines across shape; fill gaps on any full width horizontal edge.
    for r in (r0,r1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fg
    return out
PY
